caption: A 56×56×64 input passes through 1×1 (16 filters), 3×3 (16 filters, pad 1) and 1×1 (64 filters) convs, costing 1040 + 2320 + 1088 = 4448 parameters. The output is again 56×56×64, so the identity shortcut can add x back unchanged.

spec.title: ResNet bottleneck: 4448 parameters
spec.aria: A ResNet bottleneck on a 56 by 56 by 64 input: a 1 by 1 conv with 16 filters (1040 parameters), a 3 by 3 conv with 16 filters and padding 1 (2320 parameters), a 1 by 1 conv with 64 filters (1088 parameters), then an addition of the identity shortcut and ReLU, giving a 56 by 56 by 64 output; the three convs total 4448 parameters.
